issues.note: House convention allows naming a variety or place; the note targets no single language.
Bless you is real cultural background; only the achoo spelling is marginal for a verb entry.
Sneezes can be quiet; a sudden noise is more accurate than a loud one.
make someone sneeze is a genuinely typical collocation; the phrase type is acceptable.

findings.F1: The definition requires a loud noise, but sneezes are not always loud.
